title: Diagrams edit ops (v1)
description: Add, connect, change or remove diagram elements in one atomic step (one undo). Describe kinds in plain words ('.NET consumer', 'Kafka topic'); the app picks the icon and position. Put a whole request in one call. The same input as the WebMCP tool edit_diagram and the 'Ask AI' paste box (which also takes a bare array of ops).

ops.description: Use an empty list only with layout: full to rearrange the existing diagram.

kind.description: Plain words or a stencil id, e.g. 'Kafka topic', 'service.dotnet'.

sublabel.description: Second line, e.g. a topic name 'orders.created'.

key.description: Name to refer to this node later in the same call.

kind.description: async = messages/events; sync = request/response, writes to a database.
Nodes: change the stencil. Connections: 'async' or 'sync'.

in.description: Move into this boundary; null removes it from its boundary.

targets.description: Nodes, connections ('A -> B'), boundaries (contents are kept) or notes.

dryRun.description: Validate and report without changing the diagram.

Ref.description: An element: id from describe_diagram (preferred), a key set earlier in this call, an exact label, 'label (sublabel)', or for a connection 'From -> To'.

$comment: The other tools' inputs are under $tools.

describe_diagram.description: Read the current diagram as compact text: nodes with ids, kinds and labels, connections, boundaries and simulations. Call before editing an existing diagram.
